messages.subject: P Marsden — execution arrangements
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair — execution version and a fresh adviser's certificate to follow tomorrow. Could you confirm you'll be signing the certificate as relevant independent adviser, and that your client can sign electronically? We'd like both signatures and your certificate back by 27 March so payroll can process within 28 days of termination (31 March).

Best,
Tom

Tom Gallagher | Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
